title: HOW TO OLLIE WHILE RIDING THE EASIEST WAY TUTORIAL 2.0
description:
The Purpose of Braille Skateboarding is to grow the number of people who skateboard by teaching, motivating, and inspiring.  We do this by making skateboard tutorial videos covering every how to skateboard video under the sun moon and stars.  By learning ourselves and showing that no matter how old or young you can learn to skate.  Part of this is also providing a suggested path to take in learning to skate.  Then we inspire NEW people to learn to skate by making videos outside the very small world of skateboarding.  We turn an ipad into a skateboard, skate on a big screen TV, and even a door.  We focus not only on the creativity here but building the board and then all the way through to seeing what tricks can be done on it.  Skaters have always been a creative bunch of people they take the normal ideas of society and change it to create their own world.  Most people see a set of stairs we see a kick flip going down them.  Our goal here is to take people that may never have thought of skateboarding before and get them on a board. 

Brands can email kylie@brailleskateboarding.com for media inquiries. 

I have created many ways to achieve the above goal and will list them all below.  Different ways for different people so have a look through and see what fits you best.  

“You Make it We Skate it” - our most popular series enjoyed bo skaters and non skaters alike - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLjpsoptsN4KDgj9KdBVA3AXd32KKHsaCa

“Skate anything” - our series where we search out what we can possibly make skate able - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLjpsoptsN4KCGW_fghTn6MJBMzyeCJU9D

Skate board tutorials - learn for free and on your own on YouTube - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL34F060CE1BA3E968

“Worst Board at the Park” - we find the worst board and replace it with a new one for tricks.  Its all love supporting the community - https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLjpsoptsN4KCTq86gnd9lhUzZQVXGQCDZ

Skate support - need help with that trick well watch the video here and send in your clip.  We will do our best to make the video quickly but we have a lot of submissions.  The end result gets posted on @Brailleskate Instagram - https://www.brailleskateboarding.com/pages/skate-support

“Skateboarding Made Simple” - instead of YouTube tutorials where you can get lost here is a guided lesson plan to take you through the basics and beyond.  Instant digital download and get started - https://www.brailleskateboarding.com/collections/learn-to-skateboard/products/skateboarding-made-simple-volumes-1-7-instant-digital-download

Skateboard coaching - this is a totally new idea in the world of skateboarding.  Get a list of tricks to learn in and submit your clips to a skateboard coach who walks you through how to land them.  This is done through direct text messages and video sharing.  The best way to guarantee success on your board as you have a person there to help, guide, and motivate you.  This service is called “Braille Army Plus” and is a membership with a lot of benefits - https://www.brailleskateboarding.com/collections/learn-to-skateboard/products/braille-army

In person lessons - if you live in the area sign up for lessons - https://www.brailleskateboarding.com/products/private-skate-lessons

Get started with a good complete skateboard, the best beginner complete - https://www.brailleskateboarding.com/collections/complete-skateboards/products/the-best-beginner-skateboard-package?variant=37248517669026
